author: /root/feasibility_math_audit
body: Integrated audit complete; narrow isolated prototype accepted with explicit limits. I inspected Native.lean, Acceptance.lean, ClosureGuards.lean, Subjects.lean, check_completion.py, qualify.py, and qualification-r4. Helper rejects proof-dependent data domains before supported-type WHNF (Native.lean:68-74), proof-dependent proposition chains (75-83), terminal let/mdata and non-Prop results (46-55); the copied helper plus frozen Acceptance and guards independently compile under Lean 4.32.1 in my .codex/state/pitfall-feasibility/audit/native scratch. Exact goal checks retain conditional declaration types separately; premise-only goals intentionally omit conclusions (Acceptance.lean:42-63), and fixed literal h:(1:Nat)=0 remains a literal assumption rather than being existentialized. ClosureGuards.lean covers leading/interleaved let truncation and non-Prop return rejection. No source-error verdict is emitted. Independent supplied-term run in audit scratch with direct `Nat.zero_ne_one` refutation passed Witness/Refutation/Fixed with completed + replay accepted + trust accepted; Leak was rejected; Sorry was trust-rejected. Scratch receipt: .codex/state/pitfall-feasibility/audit/out/completion-alternative.json (111.9s). The initial copied run using omega failed replay with unknown `_proof_1`, matching retained r3; I credit only the direct-proof run and root r4. Root qualification-r4 terminal status is passed; 5 processes exit0, 114.63s plus 57.85s retained attempts; first three cases replay/trust accepted, negative controls rejected as expected. Frozen test verification before/after returned verified with both hashes matching. Limits remain declaration telescopes, Nat/Int/Rat data profile, supplied terms rather than discovery, fixed literal not assignment API, no production integration/full child closure. No actionable blocker to this bounded experiment.
